source_text:
Fragmenta duo in Numeros
Ἀφελεῖτε ὑμεῖς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἀφαίρεμα. Οἱ μὲν κατὰ νόμον τοῦ Μωσέως
ἱερᾶσθαι κεκλημένοι, δεκάτας ἐδέχοντο παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, ὡς μερίδα καὶ
κλῆρον Θεοῦ.
thought_title: The Levites' tithes as God's portion
orientation: Cyril is opening his commentary on Numbers by quoting the command about the offering and explaining that the Levitical priests received tithes from Israel as their share from God.
pass_a_gloss: Take away you from it an offering. Those indeed called according to the law of Moses to serve as priests received tithes from the sons of Israel, as a portion and inheritance of God.

choices.english: Take away you from it an offering
choices.why: Preserves the imperative force and the redundant pronoun 'you' of the Septuagint lemma, keeping the literal command structure
rejected: You shall take away from it an offering

choices.why: Uses the glossary rendering for ἱερᾶσθαι and keeps the perfect participle 'called' as a state
Glossary term; preserves the specific tenth-part sense

choices.english: a portion and inheritance of God
choices.why: Keeps both nouns distinct and the genitive 'of God' as source or possession, matching the literal syntax
rejected: a share and lot from God

pass_b_english: “Take away from it an offering” (Numbers 18:26). Those who were called to serve as priests according to the law of Moses received tithes from the sons of Israel as their portion and inheritance from God.

problems.quote: Those who were called to serve as priests
problems.why: Same group described with/without 'who were'—minor but could seem like different groups.

variants.text: Those who were called to serve as priests
Those called to serve as priests

problems.quote: their portion and inheritance from God
problems.why: 'from God' vs 'of God' changes meaning: received from God vs belonging to God.
problems.fix: Standardize to 'from God' or clarify possessive.

variants.text: their portion and inheritance from God
a portion and inheritance of God

edits.old: Those called to serve as priests according to the law of Moses
edits.new: Those who were called to serve as priests according to the law of Moses

edits.old: as a portion and inheritance of God
edits.new: as their portion and inheritance from God
